title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G065 G067 G068 G074 G075
note: Five-case regression batch covering completed revenue alias, per-category cheapest product projection, first order date per customer, revenue by status, and monthly order metrics.

cases.question: Calculate earnings from finished orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS completed_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show the cheapest product in each category with its price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, category, price FROM (SELECT product_name, category, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price, product_name) AS rn FROM products) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY category;

cases.question: For each customer, show their first order date.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Show revenue by order status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.status, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status;

cases.question: For each month, show order count and total units ordered.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) ORDER BY order_month;
